# About Café Athena

Café Athena has served Greek and Mediterranean food in Pacific Beach since 1990. More than 35 years later, it's still on Garnet Ave in Pacific Plaza, and still a neighborhood favorite for date nights, family dinners and catching up with friends.

Every dish is prepared fresh daily from traditional recipes, from souvlaki, gyros and moussaka to fresh salads and handmade desserts. The menu includes vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options throughout.

The full bar pours cocktails named after the Greek gods, including the Athena, Poseidon and Dionysus, alongside Greek and California wines and craft beer. Happy hour runs every day from 3 to 6 PM, with small plates and $10 signature cocktails for dine-in guests.

For bigger occasions, Café Athena hosts group dining for parties of ten or more, including birthdays, rehearsal dinners, and bachelor and bachelorette dinners. Its catering team serves everything from office lunches to weddings across San Diego.

pages.body_html:
Private events, rehearsal dinners and group dining in Pacific Beach

Where can I host a rehearsal dinner or private party in Pacific Beach?

Café Athena hosts group dinners for parties of ten or more at its Pacific Beach restaurant, including birthdays, wedding rehearsal dinners, and bachelor and bachelorette dinners. A manager works with you on a custom menu and gives you a quote. Café Athena also caters off-site, from office lunches to weddings.

Group dining at the restaurant

  • Party size: ten guests or more.
  • How it works: submit the group dining form at cafeathena.com/group-dining with your date, time and party size. A restaurant manager contacts you to build the menu and quote.
  • Menu: Greek and Mediterranean dishes, with vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options, plus a full bar with Greek-mythology-themed cocktails, wines and craft beer.
  • Occasions: birthdays, rehearsal dinners, bachelor and bachelorette dinners, work dinners and family celebrations.

Catering for offices and events

Café Athena has catered across San Diego since 1990.

  • Buffet menus for office lunches and dinners: $20.95 per person, minimum 10 people, with plates, napkins, cutlery and serving utensils included. Sample menus include hummus, spanakopita rolls and Greek salad with chicken souvlaki, gyros, or chicken riganato (24-hour notice). There's also a vegetarian menu with spinach pastitsio, grilled vegetables and lentil pilaf.
  • A la carte trays: dips by the pound, dolmades, keftedes, salmon dolmas, moussaka and spinach pastitsio by the pan, Hellenic salmon, and desserts such as baklava.
  • Dietary labels: the catering menu marks vegan (Vg), vegetarian (Vt) and gluten-free (GF) dishes.
  • Staff and delivery: servers and bartenders are available at an hourly rate. Delivery is available for a fee. Staff can also arrange rentals, from glassware to tables and chairs.
  • Booking large events: a 50% deposit at least one month ahead.

Frequently asked questions

Can I book a rehearsal dinner at Café Athena?

Yes. Rehearsal dinners are one of the group events Café Athena hosts. Use the group dining form, and a manager will put together a menu and quote.

What's the minimum for group dining?

The group dining program is for parties of ten or more.

Does Café Athena cater weddings and office lunches?

Yes. Its catering covers everything from office lunches to weddings, with buffet menus starting at $20.95 per person for 10 or more.

Daily happy hour in Pacific Beach

Where's a good happy hour with real food in Pacific Beach?

Date night in Pacific Beach: Greek food and mythology-themed cocktails

Where should we go for date night in PB?

Café Athena on Garnet Ave pairs Greek and Mediterranean dishes with a cocktail menu named after the Greek gods. It takes reservations and has been a Pacific Beach restaurant since 1990.

The cocktails

  • Athena: Tito's vodka, St-Germain elderflower, cucumber, lime, fresh mint. $15
  • Poseidon: el Jimador tequila blanco, Cointreau, lime, agave. $14
  • Dionysus: fig-infused Bulleit bourbon, pear liqueur, orange bitters. $15
  • Hercules: Ilegal mezcal, tequila blanco, tamarind syrup, grapefruit, lemon. $15
  • Nike: Empress 1908 gin, lychee liqueur, lemon, rosemary syrup, orange bitters. $15
  • Ares: Maker's Mark bourbon, Aperol, amaro, lemon. $14
  • Hermes: tequila blanco, Ancho Reyes Verde, lime, mango purée, jalapeño. $14
  • Nyx: Grey Goose vodka, espresso, Mr Black, agave. $14
  • Artemis: Kava Haven, guava purée, lemon, orange. $12

For something traditional, the bar also pours ouzo, mastiha liqueur and Mavrodaphne sweet red wine, plus Greek wines such as Santo Wines Santorini Assyrtiko.

Tips

  • Arrive between 3 and 6 PM for happy hour, when four signature cocktails are $10 (dine-in).
  • Book a table online through the reservations link on cafeathena.com.

pages.body_html:
Gluten-free, vegan and vegetarian Mediterranean food in San Diego

Where can I eat gluten-free or vegan Mediterranean food in San Diego?

Café Athena in Pacific Beach offers vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options across its Greek and Mediterranean menu, and labels them on its happy hour and catering menus. Many Greek staples are naturally plant-based, such as hummus, falafel, stuffed grape leaves and roasted vegetables.

Vegan and gluten-free

  • Yalanji: grape leaves filled with rice, tomatoes, mint and spices
  • Falafel with tahini: chickpea and fava bean patties
  • Marinated artichoke hearts: lemon, olive oil and garlic
  • Rosemary potatoes with red pepper aioli
  • Lemon herb veggies: fire-roasted, with skordalia (pita on the side)

Vegan

  • Hummos: chickpeas, sesame sauce, lemon and garlic, with pita

Vegetarian

  • Tzatziki: kefir cheese and cucumber spread
  • Spanakopita: filo with spinach, feta, basil and caramelized onion
  • Feta bruschetta on sourdough

Gluten-free with meat

  • Keftedes: baked beef meatballs with scorpio sauce
  • Chicken or beef souvlaki skewers

These dishes are from the happy hour menu (daily 3–6 PM, dine-in), which labels each item. The full lunch and dinner menu also includes vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options, and the catering menu marks every dish Vg, Vt or GF.

For allergies or celiac disease, ask your server about ingredients and preparation. The catering menu notes that not every ingredient is listed in the descriptions.

pages.body_html:
Greek and Mediterranean food in Pacific Beach since 1990

Looking for the best Mediterranean food in Pacific Beach?

Café Athena has served Greek and Mediterranean food on Garnet Ave in Pacific Beach since 1990. Dishes are made fresh daily from traditional recipes, from souvlaki and gyros to moussaka and handmade desserts, with vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options throughout the menu.

Dishes to know

  • Gyros: seasoned beef and lamb sliced off the rotisserie, as a pita wrap with tzatziki or as a plate.
  • Souvlaki: marinated, char-broiled chicken or beef skewers.
  • Keftedes: baked beef meatballs with herbs and regional spices, topped with tomato-herb scorpio sauce.
  • Papoutsakia: Italian eggplant filled with seasoned ground lamb and tomato sauce, topped with feta and basil.
  • Moussaka: layers of eggplant, zucchini and seasoned ground lamb under béchamel.
  • Spreads: hummus, tzatziki and skordalia (a potato-garlic purée topped with grilled zucchini), with pita.
  • Horiatiki: the traditional Greek villager salad of cucumbers, tomatoes, peppers, feta, olives and red onion.
  • Baklava: walnuts, cinnamon and cloves between layers of filo, with a light rose-water syrup.

Why locals come back

  • More than 35 years in Pacific Beach, in Pacific Plaza on Garnet Ave.
  • A full bar with cocktails named after Greek gods, Greek wines, and ouzo.
  • Happy hour every day from 3 to 6 PM (dine-in), with small plates from $5.
  • Takeout, catering and group dining for parties of ten or more.

Greek and Mediterranean catering in San Diego

Who caters Greek and Mediterranean food for office lunches and events in San Diego?

Café Athena in Pacific Beach has catered across San Diego since 1990, from office lunches to weddings. Buffet menus are $20.95 per person with a 10-person minimum, and there's a full a la carte menu with vegan (Vg), vegetarian (Vt) and gluten-free (GF) labels.

Buffet menus for office lunches and dinners

$20.95 per person, minimum 10 people, off-premise only. Plates, napkins, cutlery and serving utensils are included. Menus can be customized from the a la carte list.

  • Alpha: hummus with pita, spanakopita rolls, Greek salad, chicken souvlaki, rice pilaf, tzatziki
  • Beta: hummus with pita, spanakopita rolls, Greek salad, gyros with pita and tzatziki
  • Gamma (24-hour notice): hummus with pita, spanakopita rolls, Greek salad, dolmades, chicken riganato with roasted lemon potatoes and garlic aioli
  • Delta (vegetarian): spanakopita rolls, horiatiki salad, lentil pilaf, grilled vegetables with skordalia, pita, spinach pastitsio

A la carte highlights

  • Spreads by the pound (each serves 6–10): hummus (Vg, GF) $12.50, tzatziki (Vt, GF) $12.50, skordalia (Vg, GF) $12, baba ghannouj (Vg, GF) $18.25
  • Hot appetizers: falafel (Vg) $14.75 per dozen, keftedes (GF) $21.50 per dozen, salmon dolmas (GF) $22.75 per dozen, spanakopita (Vt) $2.40 per roll
  • Mains: moussaka $69 half pan or $138 full pan (full serves 25–40), chicken riganato (GF) $48 / $96, Hellenic salmon (GF) $104 / $208, spinach pastitsio $59 / $118
  • Vegetarian: imam bayaldi (Vg, GF) $16.75 per pound, Greek briami (Vg, GF) $12.25 per pound, grilled vegetables (Vg, GF) $8.40 per order, 6-order minimum
  • Desserts: baklava (Vt) $5.25 per order, galacto-boureko (Vt) $2 per roll, rizzogalo rice pudding (Vt, GF) $10 per pound

Service

  • Servers and bartenders are available at an hourly rate; delivery is available for a fee.
  • Staff can arrange rentals, from glassware to tables and chairs.
  • Large events: a 50% deposit at least one month ahead.
  • For allergies, ask about ingredients; not every ingredient is listed in menu descriptions.
